name: FAPI Collapsible
description: Provides a themeable 'collapsible' Form API render element — a fieldset-like container whose body can be expanded or collapsed, driven by a Twig template and jQuery behavior instead of core's details element.

suggests.drupal/entity_list: Render Entity List filters as collapsible sections (recommended companion module).

project_description: FAPI Collapsible adds a single custom Form API render element, '#type => collapsible', for developers who want a fieldset-like wrapper whose contents can be expanded and collapsed without the semantics or default markup of core's 'details' element. The element class Drupal\fapi_collapsible\Element\Collapsible extends core's Fieldset render element, adds a 'collapsible' theme wrapper, a process callback that attaches the fapi_collapsible/collapsible library, and extra properties (#expanded, #name, #id_collapsible, #description, #description_attributes). hook_theme() registers the 'collapsible' theme hook and hook_preprocess_collapsible() maps the element's #children/#name/#title/#id_collapsible/#expanded/#description/#description_attributes into template variables (including a computed 'close' flag). The shipped Twig template (templates/collapsible.html.twig) renders an accessible toggle button (aria-controls / aria-expanded) plus a collapsible content region, and js/collapsible.js (a Drupal behavior over jQuery) toggles the region on click, supports mutually-exclusive groups via a data-collapsible-rel attribute, and optionally auto-closes on outside click via data-collapsible-close. The module has no routes, permissions, forms, services, config objects or config schema; it is used purely from PHP/Twig code. It can be paired with Entity List to render filters as collapsible sections.
